title: INF Stamina + Many more
script:
-- Keys: N = anti-rubberband, G = stamina, T = tackle. Drag header/pill to move, — to minimize, × to close.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer :: Player
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) :: PlayerGui
assert(PlayerGui, "[Bismuth Lite] PlayerGui not found")

-- State
local antiRubberEnabled = true
local staminaEnabled = false
local tackleEnabled = false
local speedEnabled = false
local minimized = false
local watchdogConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

-- Module refs
local SlideTackleMod: any = nil
local MoveMod: any = nil
local GuardMod: any = nil
local TackBack: {[string]: any}? = nil
local MoveBack: {[string]: any}? = nil
local MovementCorrectionRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil

pcall(function()
	SlideTackleMod = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Actions.SlideTackle)
	if SlideTackleMod and SlideTackleMod.Constants then
		TackBack = table.clone(SlideTackleMod.Constants)
	end
end)
pcall(function()
	MoveMod = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Actions.ActionMovement)
	if MoveMod and MoveMod.Constants then
		MoveBack = table.clone(MoveMod.Constants)
	end
end)
pcall(function()
	GuardMod = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Characters.LocalMovementGuard)
end)
pcall(function()
	local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Remotes)
	MovementCorrectionRemote = Remotes.Get("Characters", "MovementCorrection") :: any
end)

local ENHANCED_WALK = 19
local ENHANCED_SPRINT = 1.82
local ENHANCED_TACKLE = 1.38

--[[Stamina hook (executor only — uses filtergc / hookfunction when available)
pcall(function()
	local execFilterGc: any = rawget(getfenv(), "filtergc")
	local execHook: any = rawget(getfenv(), "hookfunction")
	if not execFilterGc or not execHook then return end
	local updateSprint = execFilterGc("function", { Name = "updateSprint" }, true)
	if not updateSprint then return end
	local mod = debug.getupvalue(updateSprint, 14)
	if not mod then return end
	local Update = (mod :: any).Update
	if not Update then return end
	local oldUpdate: any
	oldUpdate = execHook(Update, function(...)
		local data = select(2, ...)
		if staminaEnabled and data and rawget(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina") ~= nil then
			rawset(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina", true)
		end
		return oldUpdate(...)
	end)
end)
]]
-- old ver stamina
pcall(function()
    local updateSprint = filtergc("function", {Name = "updateSprint"}, true)
    if not updateSprint then return end
    local mod = debug.getupvalue(updateSprint, 14)
    local Update = mod.Update
    local oldUpdate
    oldUpdate = hookfunction(Update, function(...)
        local data = select(2, ...)
        if staminaEnabled and data and rawget(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina") ~= nil then rawset(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina", true) end
        return oldUpdate(...)
    end)
end)
-- Apply helpers
local function applyTackle()
	if tackleEnabled and SlideTackleMod and TackBack then
		for k, v in pairs(TackBack :: any) do
			if typeof(v) == "number" then
				if k == "Distance" or k == "StartupDashDistance" or k == "BallKnockSpeed" then
					SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = (v :: number) * ENHANCED_TACKLE
				elseif k == "StaminaCost" then
					SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = 0
				else
					SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v
				end
			else
				SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v
			end
		end
	else
		pcall(function()
			if TackBack and SlideTackleMod then
				for k, v in pairs(TackBack :: any) do SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function applySpeed()
	pcall(function()
		if MoveMod and MoveBack then
			if speedEnabled then
				MoveMod.Constants.BaseWalkSpeed = ENHANCED_WALK
				MoveMod.Constants.SprintSpeedMultiplier = ENHANCED_SPRINT
			else
				MoveMod.Constants.BaseWalkSpeed = (MoveBack :: any).BaseWalkSpeed
				MoveMod.Constants.SprintSpeedMultiplier = (MoveBack :: any).SprintSpeedMultiplier
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function applyAllCheats()
	if speedEnabled and MoveMod and MoveMod.Constants then
		MoveMod.Constants.BaseWalkSpeed = ENHANCED_WALK
		MoveMod.Constants.SprintSpeedMultiplier = ENHANCED_SPRINT
	end
	if tackleEnabled and SlideTackleMod and TackBack then
		for k, v in pairs(TackBack :: any) do
			if typeof(v) == "number" then
				if k == "Distance" or k == "StartupDashDistance" or k == "BallKnockSpeed" then
					SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = (v :: number) * ENHANCED_TACKLE
				elseif k == "StaminaCost" then SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = 0
				else SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v end
			else SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v end
		end
	end
end

local function revertAllCheats()
	pcall(function()
		if MoveBack and MoveMod then
			MoveMod.Constants.BaseWalkSpeed = (MoveBack :: any).BaseWalkSpeed
			MoveMod.Constants.SprintSpeedMultiplier = (MoveBack :: any).SprintSpeedMultiplier
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if TackBack and SlideTackleMod then
			for k, v in pairs(TackBack :: any) do SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v end
		end
	end)
end

-- Anti-rubberband: guard tolerances + AES + Validate hook + correction block
local guardHooked = false
local correctionBlocked = false
local GuardValidateOrig: any = nil

local function setGuardTolerances(wide: boolean)
	pcall(function()
		if GuardMod and GuardMod.Constants then
			if wide then
				GuardMod.Constants.PositionToleranceStuds = 9999
				GuardMod.Constants.VelocityToleranceStudsPerSecond = 9999
			else
				GuardMod.Constants.PositionToleranceStuds = 0.5
				GuardMod.Constants.VelocityToleranceStudsPerSecond = 0.001
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function setAESEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	pcall(function()
		local aesObj = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Characters:FindFirstChild("AntiExploitSettings") :: Instance?
		if aesObj and aesObj:IsA("ModuleScript") then aesObj:SetAttribute("LocalAntiExploitEnabled", enabled) end
		local ctx = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ContextState).Get("AntiExploitSettings")
		if ctx then (ctx :: any).LocalEnabled = enabled end
	end)
end

local function hookGuardValidate(enable: boolean)
	if enable and not guardHooked then
		pcall(function()
			local execHook: any = rawget(getfenv(), "hookfunction")
			if not (GuardMod and GuardMod.Validate and execHook) then return end
			GuardValidateOrig = GuardMod.Validate
			execHook(GuardMod.Validate, function(root: any, hum: any, ...: any)
				if antiRubberEnabled then
					pcall(function()
						local ctx: any = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ContextState).Get("LocalMovementGuard")
						local state = ctx and ctx.States and ctx.States[root]
						if state then state.CFrame = root.CFrame state.Velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity state.PositionError = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end
					end)
					return true
				end
				return GuardValidateOrig(root, hum, ...)
			end)
			guardHooked = true
		end)
	elseif not enable and guardHooked and GuardValidateOrig then
		pcall(function()
			local execHook: any = rawget(getfenv(), "hookfunction")
			execHook(GuardMod.Validate, GuardValidateOrig)
		end)
		guardHooked = false
	end
end

local function hookMovementCorrection(enable: boolean)
	if enable and not correctionBlocked then
		pcall(function()
			local gc: any = rawget(getfenv(), "getconnections")
			if not (MovementCorrectionRemote and gc) then return end
			for _, c in ipairs(gc((MovementCorrectionRemote :: any).OnClientEvent)) do if c.Disable then c:Disable() end end
			correctionBlocked = true
		end)
	elseif not enable and correctionBlocked then
		pcall(function()
			local gc: any = rawget(getfenv(), "getconnections")
			if gc and MovementCorrectionRemote then for _, c in ipairs(gc((MovementCorrectionRemote :: any).OnClientEvent)) do if c.Enable then c:Enable() end end end
		end)
		correctionBlocked = false
	end
end

local function applyAntiRubber()
	if antiRubberEnabled then setGuardTolerances(true) setAESEnabled(false) hookGuardValidate(true) hookMovementCorrection(true)
	else hookGuardValidate(false) setAESEnabled(true) setGuardTolerances(false) hookMovementCorrection(false) end
end

local function startWatchdog()
	if watchdogConn then watchdogConn:Disconnect() watchdogConn = nil end
	local tick = 0
	watchdogConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		tick += 1
		if tick % 20 ~= 0 then return end
		applyAllCheats()
		if antiRubberEnabled and GuardMod and GuardMod.Constants and GuardMod.Constants.PositionToleranceStuds < 9000 then
			GuardMod.Constants.PositionToleranceStuds = 9999
			GuardMod.Constants.VelocityToleranceStudsPerSecond = 9999
		end
		if antiRubberEnabled then
			pcall(function()
				local a = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Characters:FindFirstChild("AntiExploitSettings")
				if a and a:GetAttribute("LocalAntiExploitEnabled") ~= false then a:SetAttribute("LocalAntiExploitEnabled", false) end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

local function stopWatchdog()
	if watchdogConn then watchdogConn:Disconnect() watchdogConn = nil end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.55)
	applyAntiRubber()
	applyAllCheats()
	startWatchdog()
end)

-- Purge stale Bismuth panels / pills from every plausible parent (fixes double-pill on re-inject)
do
	pcall(function()
		for _, inst in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
			if inst.Name == "Bismuth_Panel" or inst.Name == "SoccerHub_Panel" or inst.Name == "MiniPill" then inst:Destroy() end
			if inst.Name:find("^Bismuth") and inst:IsA("ScreenGui") then inst:Destroy() end
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local hui: any = rawget(getfenv(), "gethui")
		local h = hui and hui()
		if h then for _, ch in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "Bismuth_Panel" or ch.Name == "SoccerHub_Panel" or ch.Name == "MiniPill" then ch:Destroy() end end end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
		for _, ch in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do if ch.Name == "Bismuth_Panel" or ch.Name == "SoccerHub_Panel" or ch.Name == "MiniPill" then ch:Destroy() end end
	end)
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SoccerHub_Panel"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 999
gui.Parent = PlayerGui
do local syn: any = rawget(getfenv(), "syn") if syn and syn.protect_gui then pcall(syn.protect_gui, gui) end end

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 340)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -170)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", main)
mainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(58, 58, 70)
mainStroke.Thickness = 1.2
mainStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Name = "Header"
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Active = true
header.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
local headerFix = Instance.new("Frame", header)
headerFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
headerFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -10)
headerFix.BackgroundColor3 = header.BackgroundColor3
headerFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
headerFix.ZIndex = 0

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", header)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)

title.Text = "SOCCERHUB  •  Bismuth LITE"

title.TextSize = 12

title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel", header)
sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 10)
sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 22)
sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
sub.Text = "drag header/pill  •  — minimize  •  N/G/T  •  SoccerHub.luau"
sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
sub.TextSize = 9
sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 145)
sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local function makeHeaderBtn(text: string, xOff: number): TextButton

	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
	b.Position = UDim2.new(1, xOff, 0.5, -15)

	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235)
	b.AutoButtonColor = true
	Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	return b
end

local minBtn = makeHeaderBtn("—", -70)
local closeBtn = makeHeaderBtn("×", -34)
closeBtn.TextSize = 18

local content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", main)
content.Name = "Content"

content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 44)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.BorderSizePixel = 0
content.ScrollBarThickness = 4

content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
content.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", content)
pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)

local statusFrame = Instance.new("Frame", content)
statusFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)

statusDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -4)

Instance.new("UICorner", statusDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", statusFrame)
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 0)

statusLabel.TextSize = 10

-- Single pill: child of the same ScreenGui, created once. Visible toggled via minimized.
local mini = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
mini.Name = "MiniPill"
mini.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(116, 36)
mini.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0)
mini.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
mini.Text = "  SOCCERHUB  ▶"
mini.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
mini.TextSize = 12
mini.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
mini.Visible = false
mini.AutoButtonColor = true
mini.Active = true
Instance.new("UICorner", mini).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
local miniStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", mini)

miniStroke.Thickness = 1.2

local toggles: { [string]: { btn: TextButton, dot: Frame, row: Frame, accentOn: Color3? } } = {}

local function createToggle(key: string, label: string, hint: string, order: number, accentOn: Color3?): (TextButton, Frame)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame", content)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38)
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
	st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
	st.Thickness = 1
	st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	local lb = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	lb.Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 16)
	lb.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 10)
	lb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lb.Text = label
	lb.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lb.TextSize = 12
	lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
	lb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local ht = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
	ht.Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 12)
	ht.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 27)
	ht.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ht.Text = hint
	ht.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	ht.TextSize = 10
	ht.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
	ht.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
	btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 28)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0.5, -14)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
	btn.Text = "OFF"
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 11
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225)
	btn.AutoButtonColor = false
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame", btn)
	dot.Name = "Dot"
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -10)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 205)
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	toggles[key] = { btn = btn, dot = dot, row = row, accentOn = accentOn }
	return btn, dot
end

local b0 = createToggle("antirubber", "Anti-Rubberband  ★", "Guard bypass + server block  •  N", 1, Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 90))
local b1 = createToggle("stamina", "Unlimited Stamina", "No drain  •  G", 2)
local b2 = createToggle("tackle", "Power Tackle 1.38×", "Dist + Knock + 0 cost  •  T", 3)
local b3 = createToggle("speed", "Super Speed 19", "Base 16→19  ×1.82  (watchdog)", 4)

local function setVisual(key: string, on: boolean)
	local t = toggles[key]
	if not t then return end
	local accent = t.accentOn or Color3.fromRGB(88, 166, 78)
	TweenService:Create(t.btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { BackgroundColor3 = on and accent or Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65) }):Play()
	t.btn.Text = on and "ON" or "OFF"
	TweenService:Create(t.dot, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -10), BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 205) }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(t.row, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { BackgroundColor3 = on and (t.accentOn and Color3.fromRGB(32, 42, 32) or Color3.fromRGB(36, 46, 38)) or Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38) }):Play()
end

local function refreshStatus()
	if antiRubberEnabled then
		statusLabel.Text = "●  Anti-Rubberband: ON"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 210, 170)
		TweenService:Create(statusDot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 200, 88) }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(statusStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 110, 70) }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(statusFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 34, 28) }):Play()
	else
		statusLabel.Text = "●  Anti-Rubberband: OFF — may snap"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 150, 130)
		TweenService:Create(statusDot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 90) }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(statusStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 70, 70) }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(statusFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 28, 28) }):Play()
	end
end

local function refreshAll()
	setVisual("antirubber", antiRubberEnabled)
	setVisual("stamina", staminaEnabled)
	setVisual("tackle", tackleEnabled)
	setVisual("speed", speedEnabled)
	refreshStatus()
end

b0.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	antiRubberEnabled = not antiRubberEnabled
	applyAntiRubber()
	if antiRubberEnabled then startWatchdog() end
	refreshAll()
end)
b1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	staminaEnabled = not staminaEnabled
	refreshAll()
end)
b2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	tackleEnabled = not tackleEnabled
	applyTackle()
	refreshAll()
end)
b3.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	speedEnabled = not speedEnabled
	applySpeed()
	refreshAll()
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
	if processed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
		antiRubberEnabled = not antiRubberEnabled
		applyAntiRubber()
		if antiRubberEnabled then startWatchdog() end
		refreshAll()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
		staminaEnabled = not staminaEnabled
		refreshAll()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
		tackleEnabled = not tackleEnabled
		applyTackle()
		refreshAll()
	end
end)

local function setMinimized(state: boolean)
	minimized = state
	if state then
		content.Visible = false
		statusFrame.Visible = false
		TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 40) }):Play()
		mini.Visible = true
	else
		mini.Visible = false
		TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 340) }):Play()
		task.delay(0.02, function()
			content.Visible = true
			statusFrame.Visible = true
		end)
	end
end

minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMinimized(not minimized) end)
mini.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMinimized(false) end)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	antiRubberEnabled = false
	pcall(applyAntiRubber)
	stopWatchdog()
	if guardHooked and GuardValidateOrig then
		pcall(function()
			local h: any = rawget(getfenv(), "hookfunction")
			h(GuardMod.Validate, GuardValidateOrig)
		end)
		guardHooked = false
	end
	hookMovementCorrection(false)
